name: Omarchy AI
author: Omri Ben Ami
description: Omarchy AI is a voice assistant for the Omarchy desktop: wake word, overlays, settings, and desktop integration. This marketplace entry is the settings panel that ships with it. Install the full assistant first; this bar widget alone does not run the daemon.
